column1: LIVE FIRE: these bots shoot back and every round is harder. Clear all 5. Crouch behind crates (C) and dash through shots (SPACE).
column2: 实弹对抗：这些机器人会还击，而且每一轮都更难。清空全部 5 轮。蹲在箱子后面（C），并用冲刺（空格）躲开子弹。

column1: Two bots that stand still and miss a lot. Aim, shoot and duck behind a crate.
column2: 两个站着不动、枪法很差的机器人。瞄准、射击，并躲到箱子后面。

column1: Three bots that move between cover and fire more often.
column2: 三个在掩体之间移动、开火更频繁的机器人。

column1: A heavy gunner joins in: it hits hard and takes a lot of damage. Keep moving.
column2: 一名重装枪手加入战斗：它火力凶猛，也很耐打。保持移动。

column1: A riot shield, a sniper and a drone. Shoot the shield bot in the back and break line of sight when the red laser appears.
column2: 防暴盾牌、狙击手和无人机。从背后击打持盾机器人，红色激光出现时立刻脱离视线。

column1: Everything at full strength, with grenades and a rusher. This is the real thing.
column2: 一切都拿出全部实力，还有手雷和冲锋者。这就是真正的战斗。

column1: Health restored. The next round starts in a moment.
column2: 生命值已恢复。下一轮即将开始。
所有轮次均已通过。干得漂亮。
生命值已恢复。本轮重新开始。

column1: The instructor waves you through. Take it slower next time.
column2: 教官让你直接通过。下次稳着点打。
